description: Doughnut Biotool is a spreadsheet tool for estimating a building project's biodiversity impacts over its life cycle. Its README distinguishes direct land transformation and occupation from indirect effects of construction materials, and describes an estimated local species loss. Users provide site area, land use and material quantities; outputs are impact estimates for the project scenario. Geographic coverage depends on the factor and ecological assumptions chosen. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing. The authors call it a first attempt and recommend using a more detailed local biodiversity metric alongside it. A limitation is that a life-cycle factor cannot directly measure which species a particular development will displace. The tool can compare building-design and material scenarios in urban green-infrastructure planning. The related Brightway catalogue platform supports broader life-cycle modelling. No spreadsheet or factor file was downloaded.
